a.lede: OpenAI says researchers using GPT-5.6 Sol uncovered two critical PHP vulnerabilities with severity scores of 9.2 and demonstrated working exploits, after which the company coordinated fixes.
a.title: OpenAI says ChatGPT Sol helped uncover critical PHP flaws that could affect 70% of websites

b.lede: The PHP security team has shared mitigation measures for a new remote code execution vulnerability that affects systems with non-default configurations and has no patch. [...]
b.title: PHP shares mitigation for new RCE vulnerability with no patch
